description: List a 7z archive and extract a selected entry without running its contents. Unencrypted 7z only, up to 32 MiB input, 64 MiB expanded and 1,000 entries. Solid archives are decoded within the same total expansion budget. Queues a run and returns its ID for progress and output tracking. Uses cloud allowance.
name: archive_7z
title: Open and extract 7z
